english: 「I am the one who rules the world.」
「Why... do you interfere? You base breed.」
「Foolish... though it is meaningless...\nbecause you cannot even grasp that...」
「There is no wrong in what I do.」
「I eliminate what obstructs me. That is all.」
「Stop me?\n...You will not even be granted that dream.」
「Off-spec, then... a failure, in other words...」
「You miserable little bolt...\nstill alive and getting cocky...」
「Your work is already done...\nwhy do you still exist?」
「I shall teach you once more who your master is.」
「This is... the power of a creator...」
「Only I shall exist in the new world...」
「Return to nothingness once... then I shall remake you.」
「This trash... become dust as you are.」
「I'll make sure you can never be restored.」
「Though you cling to life,\nthe result will be the same...」
「At least you live up to your hidden power...」
「Do you understand? The meaninglessness of your actions.」
「Your duty is the destruction of the world.」
「Had you not defied me, you could have lived a little longer...」
「Though you know my power...\nI suppose it can't be helped, being mere scrap iron.」
「I do not understand... why do you do this?」
「Truly one who transcends humanity...\nto think I would be driven this far...」
「That you would make ME use it...」
